knowledge-index-status.title: Index status and source
knowledge-index-status.view_required: Load the current account and project before reading index status.
knowledge-index-status.refreshing: Reading again. The previous observation remains below.
knowledge-index-status.stale: The latest read failed. The previous observation is retained and is out of date.
knowledge-index-status.denied: Current access to index status is unavailable. Protected facts have been cleared.
knowledge-index-status.error: Index status could not be confirmed. Read it again.
knowledge-index-status.current: Delivery facts from the latest successful read.
knowledge-index-status.configured: An index service is configured. This does not verify that it can answer a query.
knowledge-index-status.unconfigured: No index service is configured. Keyword discovery remains separate.
knowledge-index-status.untracked_publica: Pointers without a matching publication event
knowledge-index-status.boundary: This covers recorded event delivery only. Counts and watermarks do not prove complete provider coverage, source eligibility, query availability or model use.
knowledge-index-status.no_latest: No latest event was returned by this read.
knowledge-index-status.no_ack: No acknowledgement was returned by this read.
knowledge-index-status.unpublished: No publication: this delete applies to a retired draft.
knowledge-index-status.independent: The latest event and last acknowledgement may refer to different events. Provider watermarks and business sequences use different units.
knowledge-index-status.invalid_response: The index status response does not match its current scope or public contract.
